The '''Divora system''' was located in the [[Rifle Worlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Rim Route]] to the Rifle Worlds' [[Wodan system/Legends|Wodan system]] and to the [[Jodaka system/Legends|Jodaka system]] in the [[Corsair Outback]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Divora [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the game known as [[Divoran holochess]].<ref name="DF">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050616a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 6: Outcasts and Megalomaniacs Welcome}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Divoran holochess]]|system=Divora [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Divora system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
